title.zh: 按条件配置逻辑控制板
title.en: Wire the Switchboard to Match Each Goal

concept.zh: 同时满足门的类型与输出
concept.en: Match both the gate and the output

brief.zh: 先选对本轮要求的门，再拨动输入，让输出灯亮或灭。
brief.en: Select the required gate first, then flip the inputs so the output light is on or off as requested.

hints.zh: AND 要亮时两边都开。OR 要灭时两边都关。
hints.en: For AND to turn on, turn on both inputs. For OR to turn off, turn off both inputs.

hints.zh: NOT 的结果只随 A 改变。XOR 可以在两边一样时熄灭。
hints.en: The NOT output follows A. XOR turns off when the inputs are equal.

label.zh: 把 AND 的输出拨到 1
label.en: Set an AND gate to output 1

label.zh: 把 OR 的输出拨到 0
label.en: Set an OR gate to output 0

label.zh: 把 NOT 的输出拨到 0
label.en: Set a NOT gate to output 0

label.zh: 两边从 1 开始，让 XOR 灯灭
label.en: Start with both inputs on and make XOR output 0
